confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a small coastal town, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors are rough. Accommodation is the least certain, since east-coast prices are seasonal and July is peak season there. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor because direct knowledge of local prices is weak. The FX figure comes from RBA exchange-rate pages as shown in search results; the F11.1 table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Sri Lankan east-coast tourist towns such as Nilaveli, Uppuveli and Arugam Bay, priced somewhat above inland towns and below south-coast resort towns such as Mirissa and Unawatuna.
